transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Sana. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Sana, I'm calling because my new phone has been dropping calls every single hour. It's incredibly frustrating.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these dropped calls. I can certainly look into this for you.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Sure, it is 75745233. My name is James Sharma.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Sharma. And just to confirm, what is the phone number associated with the account?
Customer: It is 95173 72493. I live at 130 Station Road.
Agent: Thank you for that information. Let me check the network status in your area.
Customer: I've already done that on your website and it says everything is fine. I just want this device to work properly.
Agent: I understand. Please try restarting your device now while I stay on the line.
Customer: I have restarted it five times today already! This is a waste of my time. I am tired of this poor service.
Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me check if there are any firmware updates available for your handset.
Customer: This is ridiculous. If you can't fix this right now, I'm going to cancel my contract and switch to another provider.
Agent: I see. I will need to run a remote diagnostic on your device to see what is happening.
